name: Truth Be Told
summary: Party bluffing game where players guess the host's true fill-in-the-blank answer among fake answers.
rules_text: Players choose a question color. Each round one player is Host and draws a card and reads the question containing a blank. Host writes the true completion on their card. Other players simultaneously write bluff completions pretending to be Host. All cards go face-down to Host who shuffles them and removes exact duplicates, asking owners to rewrite until all unique, always keeping the true answer. Host reads all answers anonymously. Non-hosts secretly write on paddles which answer they think is true, not voting their own. Votes are revealed clockwise. Scoring: 1 point to each player who voted the true answer, 1 point to Host per vote for the true answer, 1 point to a bluff author per vote their bluff received. Erase cards, pass host left. First to 15 points wins, tie broken by one extra round.
rating_reason: Bluffing guessing game about others, turn-based, hidden answers, scores from moves.
